title: Home guide: magnets through paper
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 13 (Home practical guide and safety card: magnets through paper (portal worksheet; keep magnets away from phones and screens))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out whether a magnet works through paper.
safety: Keep magnets away from phones and screens
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put a paper clip on a sheet of paper.
Hold the magnet under the paper, not touching the clip.
Move the magnet slowly. What does the clip do?
Try two, then three sheets of paper.
